blocks.text: LOS ANGELES — The long-running legal battles between Angelina Jolie and Brad Pitt have come to an end a decade after the A-list celebrity couple split, with the actors settling a dispute over the ownership of a French winery. The actors said in a joint statement Wednesday, Nov. 25, that they had reached a settlement of the lawsuit, which transcended business matters when a legal filing from Jolie surfaced abuse allegations against Pitt. “We have settled out of court in the best interests of our family and will not be commenting further,” the statement provided by representatives for Pitt, 62, and […]...
